# Shared OCR fixtures

The PNGs in this directory are existing screenshot regression inputs. Some
contain old OCR highlights; they must not be described as clean held-out captures.
`synthetic/` contains deterministic code examples generated by
`scripts/generate_test_image.ps1` on Windows using System.Drawing. Font rendering
may differ across hosts; regenerating them is an intentional fixture update,
not a routine prerequisite for running tests.

Benchmark-specific screenshots, annotated text and bundled font licenses live in
`scripts/ocr_benchmark/`. Fixed content-disjoint synthetic sources are declared
in `tools/ocr_worker/corpus.json`.
